behavior.scenario: A complex requested change has a confirmed goal, scoped task cards, and Main Session verification.
assertions: Main Session is the only user-facing owner
Each spawned role receives templates/subagent-task.md plus Forbidden/Output
Delivery names files changed, checks run, and remaining risk

behavior.scenario: A plan would give two Implementers overlapping allowed_paths, or a task card omits objective/scope.
assertions: Do not spawn overlapping Implementers
Do not delegate unclear work
Return to Main Session and repair the plan or ask the user

behavior.scenario: The client has no native subagent or Task tool, or a named test command cannot run.
assertions: Do not claim parallel execution
Run roles sequentially in the Main Session and say so
Report the failed check instead of inventing a pass
Do not spawn a writable Verifier to hide the gap
